target_customer: Government consumer protection regulators: state attorneys general offices, city consumer affairs departments, federal and state agencies
problem: Regulators react to complaints rather than proactively finding consumer protection violations such as junk fees and subscription traps. Particularity AI agents browse live sites and prepackage evidence for cases.
business_model: B2G software sold to regulatory agencies; pricing not stated

founders.name: Kavin Kumaravel
founders.background_notes: Source: YC company page and company site.

founders.name: Christopher Bannon
prior_employers: AWS (security and compliance infrastructure, EU Sovereign Cloud)

technical_complexity.rationale: Browser agents that test checkout totals and cancellation flows and package evidence legally is demanding but built on existing agent tooling.

defensibility.rationale: Government sales cycles and evidence workflows create lock-in once adopted; early product copyable by others.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No incumbents offering proactive violation sourcing for regulators were found; the company is a Fall 2026 YC company.

market_need_then: State attorneys general are increasingly enforcing existing consumer laws against online practices (2026 legal commentary), and regulator budgets are tight. No agency customers have been named.

branding.domain_note: Uses particularity.io; incorporated as a Delaware public benefit corporation.

identity.voice_and_tone: Legal and evidence oriented: court-ready evidence.

branding.community_and_virality: Fondo (an accounting firm) blogged about the product in October 2026.

brand_strength.rationale: One third-party blog post (Fondo, 2026-10-16); otherwise no brand evidence.

outcome_analysis: Particularity is an active Fall 2026 YC company, so no outcome is available. Its niche, proactive AI case sourcing for consumer regulators, looks uncontested, but government sales are slow and no customers or funding are public.
